feature_description: Recovery workflow disable option - Recovery workflow can be disabled via configuration

test_steps.step: Set configuration to disable recovery workflow
test_steps.method: API call to PUT /api/admin/settings/recovery_workflow_enabled with value 'false'
test_steps.details: Successfully set recovery_workflow_enabled to false via API

test_steps.method: Browser E2E test with Puppeteer - clicked Admin quick login, entered MFA code 123456
test_steps.details: Successfully logged in as admin with MFA in development mode
Successfully navigated to Delinquency & Recovery page

test_steps.step: Verify 'Initiate Recovery' option is hidden or disabled
test_steps.details: Backend rejects authorize-recovery requests with message: 'Recovery workflow is currently disabled. Contact system administrator to enable recovery actions.'

test_steps.step: Verify message explaining recovery is disabled
test_steps.details: Amber warning banner displayed: 'Recovery Workflow Disabled - Vehicle recovery actions are currently disabled by system configuration. Contact a system administrator to enable recovery workflow if needed.'

test_steps.method: API call to PUT /api/admin/settings/recovery_workflow_enabled with value 'true'
test_steps.details: Successfully re-enabled recovery workflow via API

test_steps.method: Browser page refresh and visual inspection
test_steps.details: Warning banner no longer displayed when recovery workflow is enabled

screenshots: delinquency-page-recovery-disabled.png - Shows amber warning banner when recovery is disabled
delinquency-recovery-enabled.png - Shows page without warning banner when recovery is enabled

backend_changes: Added GET /api/admin/settings/recovery-workflow-status endpoint to check recovery workflow setting
Added check in authorize-recovery endpoint to reject requests when recovery is disabled
frontend_changes: Added fetchRecoveryWorkflowStatus function to fetch setting on page load
Added amber warning banner when recovery workflow is disabled
Conditionally render 'Initiate Recovery' button based on setting (disabled/grayed out when workflow disabled)
